_doc: Landing page (world.html): globe dots + per-city showcase. Each city lists only its own images (L = landing photo img/cities/<id>/landing/<name>-{900,1600}.webp, C = the city's own category card photo <base>-{800,1600}.webp). Credits: img/CREDITS.json. label: side of the city-dot label at country zoom (l/r/t/b) so nearby cities do not overlap.

gent.tagline: Medieval towers, candlelit quays and a kitchen that never stops reinventing itself.
gent.heroCaption: The Gravensteen, the Counts’ castle, still keeping watch over the old town.
